description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes raw data records related to cost aggregation by agent, environment, or category, formatting it into a structure suitable for visualization with Recharts. It handles categorization, sorting, and zero-filling for consistent grouped charts.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a grouped dataset suitable for visualization, categorizing by specified dimension, and filling in missing data for consistency.
